rules.title: General prohibition on rent control with voluntary exception
rules.requirement: Cities and towns are generally prohibited from enacting or enforcing rent control, except that municipalities accepting the chapter may adopt a voluntary rent control system where compliance is uncoerced and property owners may decline to participate.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units unless owned by a person or entity owning less than ten units or having a fair market rent exceeding $400.
coverage.owner_condition: Exempts units owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units.

rules.exemptions: Rental units owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units or having a fair market rent exceeding $400.
rules.quoted_span: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except that any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that provides: (a) after six months from the date of the initial adoption of rent control regulation by a particular city or town, compliance on the part of property owners as to the rent control regulation or any subsequently adopted rent control regulation shall be entirely voluntary and uncoerced
